ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly high-intensity white (>80%) across the central surface area with low-intensity black margins (~20%) along the trailing edges and median notch.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous white geometric field covering the majority of both lobes. Distinct dark black perimeter banding along the entire visible trailing edge. A solitary dark focal spot is visible on the inner-lower quadrant of the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, narrow U-shaped depression with a calculated internal angle of approximately 25 degrees at the vertex.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Low-frequency, low-amplitude serrations visible across the trailing edge. The left lobe exhibits more pronounced peak-to-valley variations (approx. 3-5 pixels) near the distal tip compared to the right lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Asymmetrical convexity; the left lobe displays a broad convex curve while the right lobe appears more elongated with a flatter sweep towards the tip.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-contrast, textured clusters of brownish-grey pixel blobs (barnacle colonization) localized at the distal tips of both the left and right flukes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Two faint, unaligned dark linear pixel disruptions visible on the mid-ventral surface of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent bio-fouling/parasitic clusters on the distal tips of both lobes; several small, isolated dark circular markings on the white central pigment.
